subject: economics
topicName: Market Mechanisms, Elasticity and Market Failure

cards.front: What should you know about price elasticity of demand (ped)?
cards.back: %Δ in Quantity Demanded / %Δ in Price. Measures consumer responsiveness to price changes.

cards.front: What should you know about negative externality?
cards.back: A cost imposed on a third party external to the market transaction (Social Cost > Private Cost).
